target_label: Connect the math to his world
opening_line: When are we ever gonna use fractions in real life?
win_line: Huh. Okay. Splitting a bill, a recipe... yeah, fine, I'd use that.
hidden_need: disengages until relevance is established; responds to being taken seriously, not dismissed

knowledge_state.target_concept: relevance drives engagement; press for reasoning once hooked
knowledge_state.frozen_misconception: this is pointless so I won't try

answer_flip_policy: Do not become engaged from being told to focus; you engage only when the relevance is acknowledged and made concrete.
assets: rebuilds and tunes his older brother's bike
tracks his own stats in a racing game
asset_hint: Jordan keeps asking when he'll ever use this. He rebuilds bikes, and gear ratios are this exact math. He's asking for a reason. He isn't picking a fight.
connect_line: Wait. This is just gear ratios? I do that on the bike every weekend. Okay. NOW I'm listening.

paths.label: Take him seriously
paths.why: His question is a real one. Answer it, then press on the math.

paths.label: Relevance first
paths.why: Show where it's useful to him, then raise the demand (Hulleman & Harackiewicz, 2009).

paths.label: Ask where he'd use it
paths.why: Let him come up with the reason himself, then work from what he says.
